govdocs-archive_org-nsia-GarrisonJimDavi: David Mendelsohn’s Garrison interview — May 28, 1989 — is a late interview with the DA. Garrison defended his probe to the end. The interview is revealing. The file belongs to the assassination archive. The item is a fragment of the record.
govdocs-archive_org-nsia-NewYorkDailyNew: This item — Secrets of the CIA: Marita Lorenz, creator unknown — is a press file. Lorenz was Castro’s lover turned CIA asset. Her story was wild. The file belongs to the press archive. The item is a fragment of press history.
what-maisie-knew: Henry James tells the story through little Maisie's eyes — a child shuttled between warring divorced parents. What she knows, and what she only half-knows, makes this his most touching novel. A masterpiece of innocence and perception. Through a child's half-seeing eyes, James paints grown-up folly with heartbreaking delicacy.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-bartholomew: A 1913 entry on St. Bartholomew — the apostle of the flayed skin. Johann Peter Kirsch tells his mission's tale. Tradition sent him to India and Armenia. His martyrdom crowned his labors. An apostle of the distant East. His relics rest in Benevento's shrine.
